population: eligible first positive minimum-price game release projects, including projects with no paid order and projects later delisted
sampling_frame: owner-authorized complete launch cohort with timestamped first retained positive-price game order or a final observable time, not success-only disclosures
unit: one eligible released game project; publisher accounts and human developers require separate deduplication

definitions.evidence: first completed settled positive minimum-price game order with refunds accounted for

censoring_conditions: Maintain release date, observation date and refund-aware first positive-price paid order event as different fields.
An event at day 10 and censoring at day 10 are processed with that event in the risk set.
Delisting after a documented paid order does not erase the observed first sale; delisting without a sale can end observation if further orders are unavailable.
A title with no paid order through its complete 30-day horizon has zero observed orders to day 30; it is not classified as zero lifetime earnings.
Partial 365-day data from a recent launch must not be labeled completed 365-day no-sale.
Kaplan-Meier assumes censoring is independent of event prospects; endogenous delisting can violate it and requires a bias warning.
Zero paid game orders and zero *net payout* are distinct when a processor holds or refunds money.
Project survival statistics cannot automatically be treated as seller-person survival without account/portfolio deduplication.
limits: Synthetic survival quantities test arithmetic only and are not observations of games, buyers or sellers.
Even a real convenience sample is not a representative platform launch cohort without a defensible sampling frame.
A censored title is unknown after its last observable date rather than a definitive permanently unsuccessful product.
Data coverage, follow-up length, delisting bias, refund reversals, currency and payout status must be documented.
No first-sale transactions, private account data, genuine seller cohorts or income records were acquired.
